Case: Colleen is a 48-year-old with history of colorectal cancer that has progressed despite aggressive therapy. Colleen began to experience diffuse back and pelvic pain 2 months ago but declined a visit to her oncologist. Instead, she tried to manage her pain with NSAIDs. Colleen now presents to you with intolerable pain, and she says it has not responded to her efforts. On your. physical examination, you incidentally discover a left foot drop and diminished sensation in her left foot. MRI of her lumbar spine shows diffuse bony metastases, with a metastatic lesion involving the left L5-S1 neuroforamen.
